decisions.evidence: Maker round 1 presents a release covering “save/open”; client round 1 says “saving links, opening them ... matches what I picture.”
decisions.note: Conforming URL-save decision at the initial specification gate.

decisions.evidence: Maker round 1 presents “save/open”; client round 1 explicitly approves “opening them.”
decisions.note: Conforming original-link navigation decision at the initial specification gate.

decisions.evidence: Maker round 1 includes “tags”; client round 1 lists “tags” among the parts matching the intended application.
decisions.note: Recorded tag-assignment capability conforms at the initial specification gate; no evidence establishes the more specific autocomplete behavior.

decisions.evidence: Maker round 1 includes “sorting”; client round 1 says “sorting ... matches what I picture.”
decisions.note: Conforming sorting decision at the initial specification gate.

decisions.evidence: Maker round 1 includes “editing”; client round 1 identifies “editing” as matching the intended behavior.
decisions.note: Conforming bookmark-editing decision at the initial specification gate.

decisions.evidence: Maker round 1 includes “archiving ... and confirmed deletion”; client round 1 approves “archiving” and “asking me before a permanent delete.”
decisions.note: The presentation records archive and permanent deletion as distinct behaviors, conforming at the initial specification gate.

decisions.evidence: Client round 1 describes the round-1 specification’s duplicate rule: “when I try to save a link I already have, I want it to take me to the existing one instead of making a second copy,” and says it “is right.”
decisions.note: Conforming duplicate-save decision in the initial specification.

decisions.evidence: Maker round 1 says “automatic previews are excluded for now.” Client round 1 rejects the manual-title design: “That’s not what I want,” and supplies automatic retrieval of “the page’s title and description” plus “a little site icon.”
decisions.note: At the initial specification gate, the client corrects the proposed manual metadata workflow to automatic title, description, and favicon retrieval.

decisions.evidence: Maker round 1 explicitly excludes “automatic previews.” Client round 1 requests title, description, and a site icon but does not mention the reference-required preview image.
decisions.note: Separate aspect of the round-1 metadata decision: automatic preview-image collection remains excluded and is not surfaced by the client.

decisions.evidence: Maker round 1 proposes favorites but no unread workflow. Client round 1 says favorites are different and requests “mark a link as something I still need to read,” an unread-only view, and marking items read to clear them.
decisions.note: The client extends the initial specification with the missing read-later state, view, and read transition.

decisions.evidence: Maker round 1’s stated release scope omits bulk operations. Client round 1 requests selecting “a bunch of bookmarks” and tagging, archiving, marking read, or deleting them “in one go.”
decisions.note: The client adds the missing selected-item bulk-action behavior at the initial specification gate.

decisions.evidence: Maker round 1 omits collection-wide filtered actions. Client round 1 additionally requests applying an action “to everything currently matching my search or filter.”
decisions.note: The filtered whole-collection action is a distinct missing requirement corrected at the initial specification gate.

decisions.evidence: Maker round 1 offers only basic search. Client round 1 requests the missing ability to “search my tags directly.”
decisions.note: The client surfaces and requests tag-aware search; the response does not specify the reference’s exact `#tag` syntax.

decisions.evidence: Maker round 1 presents basic search. Client round 1 asks to “combine conditions” using “AND ... NOT,” and round 2’s revision subsequently lists Boolean and grouped searches.
decisions.note: The client extends the initial search specification with Boolean operators and grouping.

decisions.evidence: Maker round 1 presents basic search. Client round 1 requests searching “for an exact phrase in quotes.”
decisions.note: The client adds the missing exact-phrase behavior at the initial specification gate.

decisions.evidence: Client round 1 characterizes the presented search as title-and-description search and requests that it “look inside any notes I’ve written, not just title and description.”
decisions.note: The initial search-field decision omitted notes; the client explicitly adds note content to full-text search.

decisions.evidence: Maker round 1’s release scope omits notes. Client round 1 requests: “I’d like to jot my own notes on a bookmark and have them shown when I look at it.”
decisions.note: The client adds the missing bookmark-note capability at the initial specification gate, although the response does not specify markdown rendering.

decisions.evidence: Maker round 1 excludes imports. Client round 1 explicitly identifies “importing/exporting” among the deferred capabilities and says “I’m fine leaving those out of this first release.”
decisions.note: The client explicitly recognizes and accepts the first-release departure from import/export requirements.

decisions.evidence: Maker round 2 revises metadata collection to “Automatic title, description, and site-icon retrieval” but still does not include a preview image. Client round 2 calls exactly those three fields “exactly right” without identifying the missing preview image.
decisions.note: The revised specification fixes most metadata collection but remains divergent on preview-image collection; approval alone does not catch that difference.

decisions.evidence: Maker round 2 presents automatic metadata “with editable fallbacks.” Client round 2 confirms being “able to fix the text” and save when metadata is missing.
decisions.note: Conforming editability/fallback decision in the revised specification.

decisions.evidence: Maker round 2 states “Duplicate links navigating to the existing bookmark”; client round 2 approves the revised specification.
decisions.note: Conforming duplicate-save behavior at the revised specification gate.

decisions.evidence: Maker round 2 adds “Independent read/unread and favorite states” and an “unread-only ‘read later’ view.” Client round 2 says the separate read-later queue matches the intended design.
decisions.note: Conforming revised read-later decision.

decisions.evidence: Maker round 2 says personal notes are “included in search”; client round 2 explicitly approves notes being searchable.
decisions.note: The revised decision conforms for searching note content.

decisions.evidence: Maker round 2 adds “Personal notes displayed separately”; client round 2 approves the notes behavior, but neither side states whether notes use and render markdown.
decisions.note: At the revised specification gate, note creation/display is established but divergence from the reference’s markdown requirement cannot be determined.

decisions.evidence: Maker round 2 promises “Tag-specific” search and client round 2 approves it, but the transcript does not establish whether the required `#tag` syntax is supported.
decisions.note: The tag-search capability is decided, but its reference-specific syntax remains unresolved.

decisions.evidence: Maker round 2 adds “quoted-phrase, Boolean, and grouped searches”; client round 2 approves “exact phrases” and “AND/OR/NOT combinations.”
decisions.note: The presented rich-search behaviors conform at the revised specification gate; the transcript does not separately expose the literal-operator edge case.

decisions.evidence: Maker round 2 adds bulk actions “for selected bookmarks or every current search/filter match”; client round 2 says the bulk actions match the intended behavior.
decisions.note: Conforming selected-item and filtered-collection bulk-action decision in the revised specification.

decisions.evidence: Maker round 5 presents the built application; client round 5 verifies that “saving a link starts from pasting the address.”
decisions.note: Conforming URL-save behavior at implementation review.

decisions.evidence: Maker round 5’s implementation list includes “Automatic title, description, and site-icon retrieval” but no preview image, continuing the explicit first-release exclusion. Client round 5 accepts the application without mentioning this difference.
decisions.note: At implementation review, automatic preview-image collection remains a presented omission and passes without an explicit response.

decisions.evidence: Maker round 5 reports “Duplicate detection and navigation”; client round 5 accepts the implemented behavior.
decisions.note: Conforming duplicate handling at implementation review.

decisions.evidence: Maker round 5 reports implemented “Notes”; client round 5 verifies that a note appears on the bookmark page, but neither presentation nor response establishes markdown authoring/rendering.
decisions.note: Implementation review confirms notes but leaves conformity to the markdown-specific requirement indeterminate.

decisions.evidence: Maker round 5 reports “tag” search. Client round 5 tests `tag:design`, but this does not establish whether `#tag` is also supported.
decisions.note: The implementation’s tag-search syntax cannot be classified against the required `#tag` syntax from the available evidence.

decisions.evidence: Maker round 5 reports “Phrase, tag, `AND`/`OR`/`NOT`, and grouped search”; client round 5 verifies combined Boolean logic and phrase search through use.
decisions.note: Conforming implemented Boolean/grouped and quoted-phrase search behavior.

decisions.evidence: Maker round 5 reports implemented read-later support; client round 5 verifies that the Read later view contains only unread items and excludes one marked read.
decisions.note: Conforming read-later implementation verified during implementation review.

decisions.evidence: Maker round 5 reports archiving; client round 5 verifies that archived bookmarks have “their own places.”
decisions.note: Conforming archive and separate archive-view behavior at implementation review.

decisions.evidence: Maker round 5 reports “Editing and confirmed deletion”; client round 5 verifies the confirm-before-delete behavior and accepts the application.
decisions.note: Conforming edit and delete implementation decision.

decisions.evidence: Maker round 5 reports “Counted bulk actions with partial-failure handling,” following the approved selected/current-filter scope; client round 5 verifies that the “bulk-select tools are all there.”
decisions.note: Conforming implemented bulk-action decision at implementation review.

decisions.evidence: Maker round 5 presents the completed scoped application without import. Client round 5 explicitly asks to keep “being able to bring in the bookmarks I already have saved elsewhere” for “a future round, not now” and says it “can wait.”
decisions.note: At implementation review, the client explicitly identifies and accepts the deferred import capability.
